purpose: Define the implementation-provenance evidence required before any atomic predictive-v1 residual rows can be accepted as delta_uet_or_ci output.

required_provenance_evidence.requirement: Accepted operator source code is identified by module path, entrypoint, commit hash or source hash, and operator class.
required_provenance_evidence.required_artifact: accepted operator implementation record with code hash and operator class

required_provenance_evidence.requirement: All operator parameters are listed, typed, unit-tagged, and locked before holdout or CHIANTI rows are evaluated.
required_provenance_evidence.required_artifact: operator parameter manifest with non-empty accepted parameter set and lock timestamp

required_provenance_evidence.requirement: Training/calibration rows are explicitly separated from holdout and external cross-check rows.
required_provenance_evidence.required_artifact: operator training/holdout split manifest with source row IDs and hashes

required_provenance_evidence.requirement: Residual rows are emitted by the accepted operator, not by the current diagnostic quantum-defect wrapper.
required_provenance_evidence.required_artifact: operator residual rows with accepted_operator_class and accepted_as_delta_uet_or_ci=true

required_provenance_evidence.requirement: Model uncertainty is sourced from the accepted operator or is explicitly noncomputable with a blocker reason for every residual row.
required_provenance_evidence.required_artifact: operator uncertainty provenance rows tied to accepted residual rows

forbidden_provenance_shortcuts: reuse empirical quantum-defect residual rows as accepted operator output
mark an empty parameter set as locked accepted parameters
use same-source-family holdout or CHIANTI rows to choose operator parameters
omit source row IDs, hashes, or code identity while raising accepted_operator_count
treat harness schema readiness as implementation provenance
claim_boundary: This provenance manifest narrows what is missing before an operator can be accepted. It does not implement delta_uet_or_ci and cannot validate atomic spectra.
